content: Ketsutsi kemɨtiuta'inɨatsie
Hikɨ 'Iyari Ketsutsi kanewitɨni makumawetsie paitɨ, mana Kauyumarie mita'inɨatakɨ.
Hikɨ huta tewiyari tukari, huta tewiyari tɨkari yuhakietɨ, kaneuhakamɨkɨkaitɨni.
Hikɨ tiyu'irɨwiyame nuaka mɨpaɨ katinitahɨawe: ―Kamɨtsɨ, xɨka 'ekɨ Kakaɨyari penu'ayatɨni, mɨpaɨ ketineutahɨawi 'ikɨ tetexi paa makɨnekɨ.
Ketsutsi mɨpaɨ katinita'eiya: ―'Utɨarika mɨpaɨ kanaineni: “Tewi paakɨ xeikɨa pɨka'ayeniereni, Kakaɨyari kemutayɨ, niukieya naitɨ peuyewetseta”.
Hikɨta kauyumarie Kerutsareme kiekariyaritsie paitɨ kaneiwitɨni, tuki yekɨrita 'amanutitewatsie kanenutiwitɨni.
Hikɨ mɨpaɨ katinitahɨawe: ―Xɨka 'ekɨ Kakaɨyari penu'ayatɨni, 'ena keneukatsuna. 'Utɨarika mɨpaɨ kanaineni:
Hikɨ Ketsutsi mɨpaɨ katinita'eiya: ―Mɨpaɨta kanaineni 'utɨarika: “Ti'aitame mɨ'akakaɨyari pepɨka'inɨataneni”.
Hikɨ tawari Kauyumarie kaneiwitɨni hɨri 'amanutitewatsie, kwiepa memɨte'aita wakwie xexuime kanixeiyatsitɨani witsimɨ'anene.
Mɨpaɨ tikuhɨawetɨ: ―'Ikɨ naime nepɨmatsiyetuirieni, xɨka pe'awaɨriyani pemɨnetsi'ayexeiyanikɨ.
Hikɨ Ketsutsi mɨpaɨ katinitahɨawe: ―Kenemie Kauyumarie. 'Utɨarika mɨpaɨ kanaineni: “Ti'aitame mɨ'akakaɨyari xeikɨa kenayexeiyani”.
Hikɨ Kauyumarie kanihayewa kaneyani, niuki tuayamete me'u'axɨaka mekaniparewiekaitɨni.
Ketsutsi kemɨtitsutɨa tikuxatatɨ
Kepauka Ketsutsi mɨtiutamari kename Wani hanutahɨiyakai, Karereya paitɨ kaneyani.
Natsaretitsie yeyaka, Kaperunaume kaneyani mana mekanikɨ harakuna tetsita mɨti'ane, Tsawuruni kwieyaritsie meta Nepɨtahari,
mɨpaɨ katinaye'ani Kakaɨyari niukameya Kitsariyaxi kemutayɨ:
Merikɨtsɨ 'ana Ketsutsi kanitsutɨani mɨpaɨ tikuxatatɨ: «Xeketeneuhayewa ke'axaxemɨteyurie, karikɨ kanehuraniri Kakaɨyari kemɨtita'aita».
Ketsutsi ketsɨweiyamete kemɨtiwaruta'ini yunaukame

Kepauka harakuna tetsita muyemiekai Karereya kwieyaritsie, kaniwaruxeiya yuhutame yu'iwamakame: xewitɨ Tsimuni Pekuru mɨtitewakai, meta 'Atɨrexi. Mana wipikɨ mekateniwiwietɨwekaitɨni harakunatsie, mɨkɨ memɨketsɨweiyametetɨkaikɨ.
Hikɨ Ketsutsi mɨpaɨ katiniwarutahɨawe: «Hikɨmɨ, nehetsie xeketeneuwiya, teɨteri waxexeɨriwamete nekanixe'ayeitɨamɨkɨ».
'Ana yapauka wipi me'uku'eiriexɨaka, hetsiena mekateniuwiya.
Manata kwitɨwa ya'amietɨ kaniwaruxeiyata yuhutame yu'iwamakame: Kakuwu meta Wani, Tsewereu niwemama, kanuwatsie mekaniyetekaitɨni yupaapa hamatɨa yuwipi memanetsikitɨatɨ. Hikɨ kaniwaruta'inieni.
Hikɨ 'ana kwitɨwa kanuwa me'uku'eirieka meta yupaapa, mekaneiweiya.
Ketsutsi kemɨtiwa'ɨkitɨakai yumɨireme

Merikɨtsɨ Ketsutsi naitsarie Karereya kwieyaritsie kanikuyeikakaitɨni, tukiteta tiku'ɨkitanetɨ, niuki 'aixɨa manuyɨne taheima mieme hepaɨtsita tikuxatatɨ, 'aixɨa meteheu'eriekame warayeitɨwatɨ naime kwiniya hepaɨtsita meta kememɨte'uka'eniwakai teɨteri.

Naitsarie Tsiriya kwieyaritsie kaniutamariwa. Mekaniwa'atɨwakaitɨni kwiniya yukɨ 'anenemekɨ memɨtekukuyekai, kukuiniyakɨ waɨkawa memɨte'uka'eniwa, kakaɨyarixi 'axamemɨ'anene memɨwanɨ'ɨ, meta kierixiekate, meta huriekate, hikɨ mɨkɨ kaniwaranayexɨrɨwakaitɨni.
Yumɨiretɨ teɨteri mekaneweiyakaitɨni Karereyatari, Tamamata Kiekaritsietari meta Kerutsaremetari, Kureyatari, meta Kurutani 'anutaɨyetari.
